text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the first day of training with Mr. 
C.B., she was nowhere to be seen at the 
training grounds. Instead, she was 
elsewhere, completely engrossed in a race 
with Katsuragi Ace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Loving nothing more than running freely, 
Mr. C.B.'s actions this time around were 
truly characteristic of her free-spirited 
nature.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, everyone expects her to 
surpass the "myth." After all, there was 
once an Umamusume who became known as a 
"myth" by achieving the Classic Triple 
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B., however, showed no interest. Her 
Trainer also believed she ought to run 
freely and respected her wishes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. expresses her gratitude for 
having her values recognized. Thus began 
the days where the two would run freely 
together in the Twinkle Series.
